name: Daisy's Nashville Lounge (Miller Place)
coordinatesSource: U.S. Census Bureau Geocoder (Route 25A, Miller Place; street-level, approximate)

evidence.note: Venue's Dine & Dance page: Sunday line dancing in Miller Place with instruction all evening and no cover.
Venue page invites beginners onto the dance floor for line dancing; says no partner and no experience needed.
Venue calendar lists Crash My Party (Luke Bryan tribute) at Miller Place on Saturday Oct 3, 8 PM.

dancing.notes: Daisy's holds Sunday line dance nights with an instructor, no partner or experience needed. Saturday band nights are party nights where people dance in front of the band.

description: A Nashville-themed country bar and restaurant on Route 25A in Miller Place. It has live country and cover bands, karaoke and a weekly line dance night.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Some map listings show 307 Route 25A; the venue's own site says 275 Route 25A, Suite 33. Facebook page is shared with the Patchogue location.
